component.name: GoveeHome
component.summary: Control Govee lights and sync them with your screen and music

description.p: A desktop app for Govee LED strips, TV backlights, lamps and bulbs. Lights on your network are found automatically and controlled directly over the LAN, without the cloud.

ul.li: Power, brightness, colour, white temperature, saved colours and sleep timers
Screen sync: lights follow the colours on your screen, per segment on DreamView capable lights
Music sync from whatever the PC plays, no microphone needed, with 25 palettes or your own colours
143 built-in effects and colour patterns that run without the cloud, with animated previews
Segment colours, your own animations, import and export
Groups, and lights that follow the computer to sleep and back
Works on Wayland (GNOME, KDE Plasma) and X11
Optional Govee cloud API key for lights without LAN control and for scenes

description.p: This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Govee.
26 colour patterns for the effects page. Animations made from painted frames, playable on any light. Import and export of your presets and animations.

Segment colours: give every segment of a light its own colour, with fills, presets and brightness per segment. Schedules: lights on and off, colours and a sunrise wake-up at set times. A segments command for the command line.
More colourful screen sync per segment, and 50 screen parts for more detail, with a switch back to 9 parts.
Screen sync splits the screen into 9 parts and sends each segment the colour of the part it sits next to. Fixes the cut-off hint on the effects and music pages.
Clearer screen sync colours, 15 slow and smooth effects, and music sync with a Feel setting and a sensitivity that changes what the lights react to.
New default screen sync style "Whole light, like GoveeScreen": each light shows the colour of the screen and its brightness follows the screen.
Check capture colours: detects and fixes screen captures with swapped colour channels (a KDE Plasma bug), so screen sync shows the colours that are on screen.
Colour test that finds out whether a light understands segment streaming or only plain colours. Streaming is now only assumed for lights where it is known to work.
Screen sync sends clean, vivid colours (Vividness, like Govee's own app), so lights with white LEDs such as the H6056 no longer turn white.
Screen sync on KDE Plasma: plain RGB capture, KWin buffer limit, colour boost for washed-out (HDR) capture, and a diagnostics report. 35 more effects, 102 in total.
Screen sync shows real colours instead of grey or white, and 30 new animated effects with live previews.
Screen sync shows colours again instead of white: the lights follow a video playing in a window, and the new Colourful colour pick ignores white and grey areas.
Faster screen capture without flashing, light bar support (H6056 and others), choosing the lights for each light show, 25 music palettes with your own colours, and 37 effects with more options.
Built-in updater: GoveeHome checks GitHub for new versions and installs them.
Much more accurate and faster screen sync, music sync, effects, groups, colour correction, saved colours, timers, background mode and cloud segment control.
